preserved_iteration_history.outcome: All 502 actual baseline checks passed. The first temporary footer matcher incorrectly failed sampled Usables; independently corrected from retained source/log without replacing the original record.
847 checks had 2 failures: the lowest-power source was outside the shortened intake reach. Test geometry corrected by one cell.
Equipment test parse failure: constant Panel shadowed the native class; renamed ActorPanel.
Temporary harness omitted editor import, causing missing global class parser failures. Import made mandatory before tests.

1396 native checks had one failure. Native physical-state import retired body masks, so an earlier source_blocked refusal replaced the expected later construction reason. Test now checks the actual context and earlier guard.
Six focused tests passed, 2203 assertions. The Main test used nonexistent demo_bridge field and failed with a runtime error despite a zero-failure footer; the runner correctly retained the failure.
Main test used a diagnostic-only snapshot on an ordinary World and accessed reset context too early. Aborted coroutine manually interrupted; retained as failed/incomplete.
All 15 scoped tests passed: 11943 counted assertions plus genuine failed-tick suite; Main 77 assertions with closed IN, FreeMass and Brine quantities.

Native 1609 assertions passed, including terminal legacy lab refusal. Main 124 assertions had 6 failures: wall refused safely before native admission; requested aim exceeded wrist limits and did not point at masked source; ordinary control reused a cancelled generation. Test conditions corrected; full quantities still closed.

Native 1614 and equipment 99 assertions passed, including terminal worker queue_reset reconstruction and strict v2 receipt budget bounds. Main 133 assertions had 5 failures: under-actor aim still exceeded wrist limits; ordinary control still used a cancelled generation.

Main 137 assertions had 2 failures confined to ordinary U10 after worker restart. Actual wall and masked-source controls passed. Fresh generation removed prior cancellation failure and exposed start_worker selecting sampled ownership, leaving physical admission suspended. Candidate retained for the owner restart fix.

All 13 focused/affected routes passed: 11188 counted assertions plus genuine failed-tick suite. Main 148 assertions passed after the narrow retained physical-owner restart fix. The final positional control verified every witnessed stored Water cell remained unchanged under its actual body mask before and after refusal. Ordinary U10 accepted its v1 pulse after restart; independent joined censuses measured its sink.

limits: Host-local before/after native observations under exclusive owner; no new native command receipt is claimed.
Maximum distinct phase claimants is task participation, not simultaneous CPU utilization.
Fault injections deliberately skip a later erase or invalidate copied readback; native-only genuine fault controls are separate.
All positive inventory closures exclude unrelated chemistry/external edits; masked source and positional wall checks are separate controls.
An IN physical-state import retires its initial construction receipt and native transient-mask registration; metered reconstruction is required.
Draft-skipped hosted jobs do not constitute passes.
